user_prompt: In the space below, draw an angle that is greater than 90 degrees but less than 180 degrees.

answer.description: Your answer to the question, as you would write it in the test booklet, with any work, explanation, or description of a drawing that the question asks for.
answer.title: Answer

output.answer: Draw a point as the vertex of the angle. From the vertex, draw one straight ray going horizontally to the right. From the same vertex, draw a second ray going up and to the left so that the opening between the two rays is wider than a right angle (a square corner) but narrower than a straight line, about 135 degrees. Draw a small arc inside the opening at the vertex to mark the angle, and label the angle as obtuse, for example 135 degrees.
